ex.en: I only had time to skim the report.
ex.zh: 我只有時間大略看一下報告。

ex.en: Skim the article first, then read it carefully.
ex.zh: 先略讀文章，再仔細閱讀。

skim.en: to read something quickly to get the main idea

ex.en: Skim the fat off the soup before serving.
ex.zh: 上菜前把湯上的浮油撇掉。

ex.en: She skimmed the foam from the top of the pot.
ex.zh: 她把鍋子表面的浮沫撈掉。

skim.en: to remove something from the top of a liquid

ex.en: I'd like a latte with skim milk, please.
ex.zh: 我要一杯脫脂牛奶拿鐵，謝謝。

ex.en: Skim milk has less fat than whole milk.
ex.zh: 脫脂牛奶的脂肪比全脂牛奶少。

ex.en: Can you skate?
ex.zh: 你會溜冰嗎？

ex.en: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
ex.zh: 在這個湖上溜冰安全嗎？

skate.en: to move on ice or a hard surface wearing special boots with wheels or blades

ex.en: Don't forget your ice skates.
ex.zh: 別忘了拿溜冰鞋。

ex.en: I got the roller skates for nothing.
ex.zh: 我免費拿到了一雙溜冰鞋。

skate.en: a boot with wheels or a metal blade for moving smoothly on ice

ex.en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.
ex.zh: 我覺得滑板通常比直排輪便宜。

ex.en: He rides his skateboard to school.
ex.zh: 他踩滑板上學。

skateboard.en: a short board with wheels that you stand on and ride

ex.en: Do you skateboard?
ex.zh: 你玩滑板嗎？

ex.en: The kids skateboard in the park every day.
ex.zh: 孩子們每天在公園玩滑板。

skateboard.en: to ride on a board with wheels

ex.en: Jiro made a sketch of Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 次郎畫了一幅富士山的素描。

ex.en: The architect showed us a rough sketch of the building.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看了大樓的草圖。

ex.en: Tom sketched a picture of an elephant for Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆畫了一張大象素描給瑪麗。

ex.en: Can you sketch it for me on this piece of paper please?
ex.zh: 可以請你在這張紙上幫我畫個草圖嗎？

sketch.en: to make a quick simple drawing

ex.en: Let me sketch out the plan for you.
ex.zh: 我來為你概略說明這個計畫。

ex.en: The manager sketched out the new strategy at the meeting.
ex.zh: 經理在會議上概述了新策略。

sketch.en: to describe or plan something in a general way

ex.en: We're very skeptical.
ex.zh: 我們非常懷疑。

ex.en: Many people are skeptical about the actual effects of traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.zh: 很多人對中藥的實際療效抱持懷疑態度。

ex.en: My manager is skeptical about the new plan.
ex.zh: 我的主管對新計畫持保留態度。

skeptical.en: having doubts about whether something is true or good

skeptic.zh: 懷疑者、抱持懷疑態度的人

ex.en: I was a skeptic at first, but the product really works.
ex.zh: 我起初很懷疑，但這個產品真的有效。

ex.en: Skeptics doubt the plan will succeed.
ex.zh: 持懷疑態度的人認為這個計畫不會成功。

skeptic.en: a person who doubts that something is true or good

ex.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
ex.zh: 英語流利是現今很搶手的技能。

ex.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
ex.zh: 你要學的是真本事，而不只是表面的知識。

ex.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
ex.zh: 她敏銳的觀察力讓她很適合當攝影師。

skill.en: the ability to do something well, usually from training or practice

ex.en: Skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight for too long.
ex.zh: 皮膚不該長時間曝曬在陽光下。

ex.en: Staying up late is terrible for your skin.
ex.zh: 熬夜對皮膚很不好。

ex.en: This medicine will cure you of your skin disease.
ex.zh: 這藥可以治好你的皮膚病。

skin.en: the outer layer that covers the body

ex.en: Please scrape the skin off the potatoes.
ex.zh: 請把馬鈴薯的皮削掉。

ex.en: Banana skins can be very slippery.
ex.zh: 香蕉皮可能很滑。

skin.en: the outer covering of a fruit or vegetable

ex.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
ex.zh: 你曾經夢想過在天空飛翔嗎？

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: Living in the city makes me miss starry night skies the most.
ex.zh: 住在城市裡，我最懷念的是夜晚的星空。

sky.en: the space above the earth where you see the sun, moon and clouds

ex.en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
ex.zh: 我喜歡這件裙子，可以試穿嗎？

ex.en: Long skirts are out of fashion now.
ex.zh: 現在長裙過時了。

ex.en: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
ex.zh: 我想試穿那件藍色條紋裙。

skirt.en: a piece of women's clothing that hangs from the waist

ex.en: The minister skirted the question.
ex.zh: 部長迴避了這個問題。

ex.en: Don't skirt around the issue.
ex.zh: 別迴避這個問題。

skirt.en: to avoid dealing with a problem or topic

ex.en: Is this the first time that you've ever skied?
ex.zh: 這是你第一次滑雪嗎？

ex.en: He skis in Hokkaido every winter.
ex.zh: 他每年冬天都去北海道滑雪。

ex.en: We went skiing in Japan last winter.
ex.zh: 我們去年冬天去日本滑雪。

ski.en: to move over snow on long narrow boards fixed to your boots

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
ex.zh: 我想買一雙滑雪靴。

ex.en: You can rent skis at the ski resort.
ex.zh: 你可以在滑雪場租滑雪板。

ski.en: a long narrow board for sliding over snow, or relating to this sport

ex.en: Jane skipped the questions she couldn't answer.
ex.zh: 珍跳過了她不會回答的問題。

ex.en: Let's skip the introduction and start the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們跳過開場介紹，直接開會吧。

skip.en: to leave something out and go on to the next thing

ex.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
ex.zh: 偶爾不吃早餐也沒什麼大不了。

ex.en: Do you know why he skipped class today?
ex.zh: 你知道他今天為什麼翹課嗎？

skip.en: to not do something you usually do, such as eating or going to class

ex.en: She is skipping rope.
ex.zh: 她在跳繩。

ex.en: The children skipped happily down the street.
ex.zh: 孩子們開心地沿街蹦蹦跳跳。

skip.en: to jump lightly over a rope, or to move with small jumps

ex.en: He is a skilled carpenter who builds beautiful furniture.
ex.zh: 他是個技術純熟的木工，做出漂亮的家具。

ex.en: The company is looking for skilled workers.
ex.zh: 公司正在徵求有技術的員工。

ex.en: She is skilled at solving difficult math problems.
ex.zh: 她很擅長解決困難的數學問題。

ex.en: Scientists found an ancient skull in the cave.
ex.zh: 科學家在洞穴裡發現了一個古代頭骨。

ex.en: A helmet protects your skull if you fall off your bike.
ex.zh: 如果你從腳踏車上摔下來，安全帽能保護你的頭骨。

ex.en: Skiing is very popular in Japan during the winter.
ex.zh: 滑雪在日本冬天非常受歡迎。

ex.en: She went skiing with her cousins over the holiday.
ex.zh: 她假期和表兄弟姊妹去滑雪。

ex.en: My brother broke his leg while skiing last year.
ex.zh: 我哥哥去年滑雪時摔斷了腿。

ex.en: He was a tall, skinny boy with big glasses.
ex.zh: 他是個戴大眼鏡、又高又瘦的男孩。

ex.en: The stray cat looked skinny and hungry.
ex.zh: 那隻流浪貓看起來又瘦又餓。

ex.en: She bought a pair of skinny jeans.
ex.zh: 她買了一件緊身牛仔褲。

ex.en: Skinny pants don't suit me; I prefer loose ones.
ex.zh: 緊身褲不適合我，我比較喜歡寬鬆的。

ex.en: He cooked the eggs in a hot skillet.
ex.zh: 他用熱的平底煎鍋煎蛋。

ex.en: Heat a little oil in a skillet before adding the onions.
ex.zh: 加入洋蔥前，先在平底鍋裡把少許油加熱。

ex.en: The skier raced down the snowy slope at high speed.
ex.zh: 那位滑雪者以高速衝下積雪的斜坡。

ex.en: As a beginner skier, I fell many times on the first day.
ex.zh: 身為初學的滑雪者，我第一天跌倒了很多次。

ex.en: The museum has a complete skeleton of a dinosaur.
ex.zh: 博物館有一具完整的恐龍骨架。

ex.en: The human skeleton has more than two hundred bones.
ex.zh: 人體骨骼有兩百多塊骨頭。

ex.en: First write a skeleton of the essay, then fill in the details.
ex.zh: 先寫出文章的大綱，再補上細節。

ex.en: The company kept only a skeleton staff during the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期間，公司只留下最少的人手。

ex.en: The skipper steered the boat safely into the harbor.
ex.zh: 船長把船安全地駛進港口。

ex.en: Our team's skipper gave a short speech before the game.
ex.zh: 我們隊的隊長在比賽前簡短地說了幾句話。

ex.en: Her story was met with skepticism by the teacher.
ex.zh: 老師對她的說法抱持懷疑。

ex.en: A little skepticism is healthy when you read online news.
ex.zh: 閱讀網路新聞時，保持一點懷疑是好的。

ex.en: She is a skilful driver who stays calm on busy roads.
ex.zh: 她是個熟練的駕駛，在繁忙的路上也很冷靜。

ex.en: The skilful craftsman carved a beautiful bird from wood.
ex.zh: 這位技藝精湛的工匠用木頭雕出一隻漂亮的鳥。

ex.en: We watched the city skyline light up at night.
ex.zh: 我們看著城市的天際線在夜晚亮起燈光。

ex.en: The new tower has changed the skyline of the harbor.
ex.zh: 這座新大樓改變了港口的天際線。

ex.en: The skater spun gracefully across the ice.
ex.zh: 那位溜冰選手優雅地在冰上旋轉。

ex.en: A young skater practiced tricks at the park.
ex.zh: 一位年輕的滑板玩家在公園裡練習特技。

ex.en: The car skidded on the wet road and hit a fence.
ex.zh: 車子在濕滑的路面打滑並撞上了圍籬。

ex.en: Be careful, or your bike will skid on the ice.
ex.zh: 小心點，不然你的腳踏車會在冰上打滑。

ex.en: The truck went into a skid when the driver braked hard.
ex.zh: 司機緊急煞車時，卡車開始打滑。

ex.en: We heard the skid of tires on the road outside.
ex.zh: 我們聽到外面路上輪胎打滑的聲音。

ex.en: The new skyscraper is taller than any building in the city.
ex.zh: 這棟新摩天大樓比城裡任何建築都高。

ex.en: From the top of the skyscraper you can see the whole harbor.
ex.zh: 從摩天大樓的頂端可以看到整個港口。

ex.en: The chef skilfully cut the fish into thin slices.
ex.zh: 主廚熟練地把魚切成薄片。

ex.en: She skilfully avoided answering the question.
ex.zh: 她巧妙地避開了這個問題。

ex.en: The doctor examined the skeletal structure in the X-ray.
ex.zh: 醫生檢視了X光片中的骨骼結構。

ex.en: Calcium is important for skeletal health.
ex.zh: 鈣對骨骼健康很重要。

ex.en: The skeletal trees stood bare in the winter fog.
ex.zh: 光禿的樹木像骨架般立在冬天的霧中。

ex.en: The stray cat looked thin and almost skeletal.
ex.zh: 那隻流浪貓看起來瘦得幾乎只剩骨頭。

ex.en: Bad data can skew the results of the survey.
ex.zh: 不良的資料會扭曲調查的結果。

ex.en: The reporter skewed the story to make it more exciting.
ex.zh: 記者為了讓報導更刺激而扭曲了內容。

ex.en: The picture on the wall is skew, so please fix it.
ex.zh: 牆上的畫歪了，請把它擺正。

ex.en: The skew line on the graph shows a clear trend.
ex.zh: 圖表上的斜線顯示出明確的趨勢。

ex.en: She is a skillful driver who stays calm in heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 她是個技術嫻熟的駕駛，在車多時也能保持冷靜。

ex.en: The skillful chef prepared the fish in just a few minutes.
ex.zh: 那位技巧高超的廚師幾分鐘就料理好魚。

ex.en: It was a skillful move that surprised the other players.
ex.zh: 那是一著高明的招數，讓其他選手大吃一驚。

ex.en: House prices continue to skyrocket in the city.
ex.zh: 這座城市的房價持續飆漲。

ex.en: Sales skyrocketed after the video went viral.
ex.zh: 那支影片爆紅後，銷量暴增。

ex.en: He put pieces of chicken and peppers on each skewer.
ex.zh: 他把雞肉塊和青椒串在每支烤肉籤上。

ex.en: Soak the wooden skewers in water before grilling.
ex.zh: 烤之前先把竹籤泡在水裡。

ex.en: She skewered a piece of meat with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用叉子叉起一塊肉。

ex.en: The cook skewered the shrimp and put them on the grill.
ex.zh: 廚師把蝦子串起來放到烤架上。

skye.zh: 斯凱島（蘇格蘭西部的島嶼）

ex.en: The Isle of Skye is known for its rugged mountains.
ex.zh: 斯凱島以崎嶇的山脈聞名。

ex.en: We took a bridge to the Isle of Skye on our trip to Scotland.
ex.zh: 我們去蘇格蘭旅行時，走橋前往斯凱島。

ex.en: A brief skirmish broke out between the two groups of fans.
ex.zh: 兩群球迷之間爆發了一場短暫的小衝突。

ex.en: The two countries have had several border skirmishes this year.
ex.zh: 這兩個國家今年已發生數次邊境小衝突。

ex.en: The two brothers often skirmish over who controls the remote.
ex.zh: 兄弟倆常為了誰拿遙控器而小吵一番。

ex.en: Troops skirmished with the enemy near the bridge.
ex.zh: 部隊在橋邊與敵軍發生了小規模的交戰。

ex.en: The skylight fills the kitchen with natural light.
ex.zh: 天窗讓廚房充滿自然光。

ex.en: Rain tapped softly on the skylight above my bed.
ex.zh: 雨水輕輕敲打著我床上方的天窗。

ex.en: The chef skillfully cut the fish into thin slices.
ex.zh: 主廚熟練地把魚切成薄片。

ex.en: She skillfully avoided answering the difficult question.
ex.zh: 她巧妙地避開了回答那個棘手的問題。

ex.en: We go skating at the ice rink every winter.
ex.zh: 我們每年冬天都去溜冰場滑冰。

ex.en: Roller skating is a fun way to exercise outdoors.
ex.zh: 直排輪溜冰是一種有趣的戶外運動方式。

ex.en: A skunk sprayed our dog in the backyard last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚有隻臭鼬在後院對我們的狗噴了臭液。

ex.en: You can smell a skunk from far away.
ex.zh: 你從很遠的地方就能聞到臭鼬的味道。

ex.en: The children looked skyward when they heard the airplane.
ex.zh: 孩子們一聽到飛機聲就抬頭望向天空。

ex.en: Smoke rose skyward from the campfire.
ex.zh: 營火的煙往天空升起。

ex.en: He cast a skyward glance to check for rain.
ex.zh: 他往天空瞥了一眼，看看會不會下雨。

ex.en: The tower's skyward reach made it visible from miles away.
ex.zh: 那座塔直指天際，從好幾英里外都看得見。

ex.en: His report was sketchy and left out many details.
ex.zh: 他的報告很粗略，遺漏了許多細節。

ex.en: I only have a sketchy idea of what happened.
ex.zh: 我對發生的事只有大略的概念。

ex.en: That website looks sketchy, so don't enter your password.
ex.zh: 那個網站看起來很可疑，別輸入密碼。

ex.en: I felt uneasy walking through the sketchy alley.
ex.zh: 走過那條可疑的小巷讓我不安。

ex.en: He rowed a small skiff across the lake.
ex.zh: 他划著一艘小艇穿越湖面。

ex.en: The fisherman tied his skiff to the dock.
ex.zh: 漁夫把他的小船綁在碼頭上。

ex.en: Our class performed a funny skit at the school party.
ex.zh: 我們班在校慶派對上表演了一齣搞笑短劇。

ex.en: The comedy show opened with a short skit about office life.
ex.zh: 這個喜劇節目以一段關於辦公室生活的短劇開場。

ex.en: Mice skitter across the floor at night.
ex.zh: 老鼠在夜裡快速竄過地板。

ex.en: The leaves skittered along the sidewalk in the wind.
ex.zh: 樹葉在風中沿著人行道輕輕飛掠。

ex.en: The skimpy meal left us all feeling hungry.
ex.zh: 這份寒酸的餐點讓我們都還覺得餓。

ex.en: Her notes were too skimpy to study from.
ex.zh: 她的筆記太單薄，沒辦法拿來複習。

ex.en: The survey results were skewed because only young people answered.
ex.zh: 因為只有年輕人回答，這份調查結果有偏差。

ex.en: The picture hung skewed on the wall.
ex.zh: 那幅畫歪歪地掛在牆上。

ex.en: She carries a sketchbook everywhere she goes.
ex.zh: 她不管去哪裡都帶著速寫本。

ex.en: He filled the whole sketchbook with drawings of birds.
ex.zh: 他在整本素描簿上畫滿了鳥。

ex.en: We painted the skirting white to match the walls.
ex.zh: 我們把踢腳板漆成白色，跟牆壁相配。

ex.en: The vacuum cleaner left marks on the wooden skirting.
ex.zh: 吸塵器在木製踢腳板上留下了痕跡。

skittish.zh: 容易受驚的；神經緊張的

ex.en: The skittish horse jumped at every sudden noise.
ex.zh: 那匹容易受驚的馬一聽到突然的聲音就跳起來。

ex.en: Investors grew skittish after the bad news.
ex.zh: 壞消息出來後，投資人變得神經緊繃。
